# Symbol study data and attribution

The centerline study data in `vocabulary.js` is derived from symbol redraws published by contributors to the Independent Witch Hat Atelier Wiki, including Chromatic Flare. The linked file pages identify the original contributors and file histories. This derived vector collection is shared under [CC BY-SA 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/), following the source wiki's stated default license; underlying *Witch Hat Atelier* designs belong to Kamome Shirahama / Kodansha. This is an unofficial fan study tool.

Changes: thresholding, centerline extraction, path simplification, normalization and game metadata. No manga pages, descriptions or complete panels are bundled. Geometry comes from the displayed designs; interpretation certainty is independently marked and must not be taken as authoritative canon. This license notice covers the derived study vector collection, not unrelated application code or original game artwork.

Source catalogue snapshot: 17 October 2026. A missing design is never replaced with an invented symbol.
